title: Amabie experiment spec
description: Declarative input to the attested proof pipeline: `amabie run <spec.json>`, `amabie prove <spec.json>`, `amabie check <spec.json>`. Mirrors the strict validator in packages/core/planner/src/index.ts (validateSpec), which is authoritative: this schema is the published, machine-readable contract for authors and tooling; the runtime validator is what actually gates execution. Two rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced only at runtime: dependency.baseline must differ from dependency.candidate, and every argv must be non-empty after placeholder expansion (see docs/SPEC-FORMAT.md).

schema.description: Spec format version. 1 is the legacy shape; 2 is current.

id.description: Experiment identity. Used as the run directory name and by `report` to find the latest evidence.

dependency.description: The dependency whose version is swapped between the two arms.

baseline.description: Version installed in the baseline arm. Must differ from `candidate` (runtime-enforced).

candidate.description: Version installed in the candidate arm. Must differ from `baseline` (runtime-enforced).

dependency.$comment: baseline != candidate cannot be expressed in JSON Schema (cross-property comparison); validateSpec enforces it.

downstream.description: The real project whose own test suite is used as the evidence engine. Fetched by content: pinned 40-hex commit only, never a branch or tag.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex commit SHA. Branches and tags are rejected on purpose: the arms must be reproducible from the record alone.

commands.description: Argv arrays only — never shell strings. Placeholder tokens are expanded by the pipeline (see docs/SPEC-FORMAT.md).

prepare.description: Run once, before either arm, in the fetched downstream checkout. Normally the reproducible install.

toolchainOverrides.description: Toolchain pins applied IDENTICALLY to both arms and recorded in evidence.environment. Anything that differs between arms must not live here.

build.description: Optional build step (null when the project needs none). Runs in each arm before the test command.

swap.description: The act that makes the candidate differ. Must contain a {candidate} token, and is appended after the prepare step in each arm.

test.description: The evidence engine: the real test command of the downstream project. Its runner output is what the classifier reads.

repeats.description: Rounds per arm. Both are >= 2 on purpose: a single baseline round makes the FLAKY guard (rule 2) unreachable, and a regression needs reproduction.
repeats.$comment: validateSpec enforces `typeof === 'number'` and `>= 2`; integer is the intent and what the shipped fixtures use.

timeoutSecs.description: Per-stage timeouts. A timeout is a killed round (exit -1) and therefore an infrastructure classification, never a test result.

environmentNotes.description: Human-readable notes about environment decisions. Recorded in the evidence bundle; carries no verdict authority.

notes.description: Free-form author notes. Never read by the classifier.

argv.description: One command as an argv array. Never a shell string: no shell is involved, so quoting cannot silently change meaning.

toolchainOverrides.yargs: 16.2.2 — era-consistent patch of mocha@10's CLI dependency; identical in both arms.

environmentNotes.testCommandNote: mocha is the core of the repo's own `test` script; the bundlesize packaging step is excluded.
